title: Linear extension by zero
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $j\colon U\to X$ an open immersion.
With $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ ([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]) and module
objects as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], the *linear extension by zero*

$$
j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\colon\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}
$$

is the linearization ([sk-def-sfb-transport]) of the extension by zero $j^{\Ab}_!$ of
abelian sheaves through the projection formula of [lem-sfb-open-projection-formula]:
it sends a $j^*\Lambda_X$-module $M$ to $j^{\Ab}_!M$ with the $\Lambda_X$-action

$$
\Lambda_X\otimes j^{\Ab}_!M\cong j^{\Ab}_!(j^*\Lambda_X\otimes M)
\xrightarrow{\;j^{\Ab}_!(\text{action})\;}j^{\Ab}_!M .
$$

Its underlying sheaf functor is $j^{\Ab}_!$, it is exact, and it is left adjoint to
the transport $\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to
\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}$.

proof.text: Put $\mathcal C=\Sh(U_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$, $\mathcal D=\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$, and $\mathcal B=\Lambda_X$. The pulled-back-coefficient construction gives the monoid object $\mathcal B$ (commutative since $\Lambda$ is). For the sheaf tensor products, $S=j^*_{\Ab}\colon\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ is strong monoidal by [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal]. For the open immersion $j$, [sk-def-sfb-finite-lower-shriek] supplies the exact functor $P=j^{\Ab}_!\colon\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and its adjunction $P\dashv S$. Thus $S\mathcal B=j^*\Lambda_X$ has its transported monoid structure, and these are exactly the coefficient objects in the displayed source and target.

source.place: Proof, linearization and lifted adjunction; final exactness argument

proof.text: The isomorphisms of [lem-sfb-open-projection-formula] are the canonical projection-formula maps for this adjunction. Clause 4 of [sk-def-sfb-transport] says that invertibility of these canonical maps makes them a coherent projection formula; hence clause 3 applies with $\mathcal B=\Lambda_X$. Define $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!=P_{\mathcal B}$. On an object $(M,\gamma_M)$ its underlying object is $PM$ and its action is $\mathcal B\otimes PM\xrightarrow{\pi_{\mathcal B,M}^{-1}}P(S\mathcal B\otimes M)\xrightarrow{P\gamma_M}PM$, precisely the action in the statement. Unitality and associativity are part of that linearization assertion. On a module morphism $a\colon M\to N$, use $Pa$. Naturality of $\pi^{-1}$ and the identity $a\gamma_M=\gamma_N(S\mathcal B\otimes a)$ give $Pa\,P\gamma_M\,\pi^{-1}_{\mathcal B,M}=P\gamma_N\,\pi^{-1}_{\mathcal B,N}(\mathcal B\otimes Pa)$, so this is a module morphism. The identity and composition equations are those of $P$. Consequently forgetting modules identifies the constructed functor with $j^{\Ab}_!$ on both objects and morphisms.

source.place: Proof, linearization and lifted adjunction; final exactness argument

proof.text: Apply clause 4 of [sk-def-sfb-transport] to the same adjunction $P\dashv S$ and the canonical invertible projection-formula maps from step 2. It identifies the linearized right adjoint with $\operatorname{mapMod}(S)$ and gives $P_{\mathcal B}\dashv\operatorname{mapMod}(S)$. Here the right-hand functor sends a $\mathcal B$-module $N$ to the $S\mathcal B$-module $SN$, with action induced by the strong monoidal structure of $S$. With the substitutions in step 1, this is exactly the asserted adjunction to $\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$, without changing scalars to $\Lambda_U$.

source.place: Proof, linearization and lifted adjunction; final exactness argument

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives] to the small pro-étale sites of $U$ and $X$ (using their small skeletons as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]); it gives that $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ are abelian. For the sheaf tensor products, [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-closed] gives additivity in each variable and preservation of colimits by tensoring with any sheaf. In particular $S\mathcal B\otimes-$ and $\mathcal B\otimes-$ are right exact. The underlying functor $P$ is exact by [sk-def-sfb-finite-lower-shriek]; it is additive: as a left adjoint it preserves the initial (zero) object and binary coproducts, which in abelian categories are biproducts; now use the formula $a+b=\nabla\circ(a\oplus b)\circ\Delta$. Step 2 gives $U_{\mathcal B}\circ P_{\mathcal B}=P\circ U_{S\mathcal B}$, including the equality on morphisms. All hypotheses of [det-prop-sfb-module-pullback-exact-lifted] now hold with $\mathcal R=S\mathcal B$, $\mathcal S=\mathcal B$, $F=P$, and $G=P_{\mathcal B}$. Its conclusion gives that $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!$ is additive and exact, preserving finite limits and finite colimits.
